nodes.name: executor.rs
nodes.summary: Executes matched hooks for a lifecycle event — running command, prompt, and http hook entries concurrently with per-hook timeouts — and implements the exit-code-2 blocking-feedback contract for command hooks.

nodes.name: HookResult
nodes.summary: Result of executing a single hook: success flag, captured stdout/stderr, duration, and exit code (for the exit-code-2 blocking contract).

nodes.name: HookExecutor
nodes.summary: Loads `.orgii/hooks.json` for a workspace and runs matched hooks concurrently for a given event, supporting command (shell), prompt (text injection), and http (webhook) hook types with regex tool-name matching.

nodes.name: matcher_applies
nodes.summary: Checks whether a command hook's tool-name matcher (an anchored regex, or `*`/empty for all) matches the current tool name, falling back to exact string comparison on invalid regex.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for the lifecycle hook system; declares the config/dispatch/events/executor submodules and re-exports `HookEvent` and `HookExecutor` as the public API surface.

nodes.name: tests.rs
nodes.summary: Integration test suite for the hooks system covering config parsing/merging, concurrent hook execution, matcher filtering, timeout handling, compaction dispatch, and hook-decision parsing.

nodes.name: config_parse_valid_json
nodes.summary: Verifies a well-formed hooks.json parses into the expected `HooksConfig` structure.

nodes.name: config_merge_concatenates_same_event
nodes.summary: Verifies global and workspace hook entries for the same event are concatenated rather than one overriding the other.

nodes.name: config_merge_combines_different_events
nodes.summary: Verifies global and workspace configs covering different events are both retained after merge.

nodes.name: config_merge_empty_global_returns_project
nodes.summary: Verifies merging an empty global config with a populated workspace config yields just the workspace entries.

nodes.name: config_merge_empty_project_returns_global
nodes.summary: Verifies merging a populated global config with an empty workspace config yields just the global entries.

nodes.name: executor_detects_registered_hooks
nodes.summary: Verifies `HookExecutor::has_hooks_for` correctly reports whether an event has registered hooks.

nodes.name: executor_run_echo_command
nodes.summary: Verifies a simple echo command hook runs successfully and captures its stdout.

nodes.name: executor_passes_env_vars_to_command
nodes.summary: Verifies `HookContext` env vars are passed through to the spawned command hook process.

nodes.name: executor_injects_hook_event_env
nodes.summary: Verifies the executor injects an ORGII_HOOK_EVENT env var identifying the firing event into command hooks.

nodes.name: executor_handles_failing_command
nodes.summary: Verifies a non-zero-exit command hook is reported as failed with captured stderr.

nodes.name: executor_timeout_reports_failure
nodes.summary: Verifies a hook exceeding its timeout is reported as a failed result rather than hanging.

nodes.name: executor_preserves_config_order_in_results
nodes.summary: Verifies concurrently-run hook results are returned in config order regardless of completion order.

nodes.name: executor_runs_hooks_concurrently
nodes.summary: Verifies multiple hooks for one event run concurrently rather than sequentially, bounding total time by the slowest hook.

nodes.name: executor_matcher_skips_non_matching_tool_in_concurrent_run
nodes.summary: Verifies a matcher-gated hook is skipped when the firing tool name doesn't match, even during concurrent execution.

nodes.name: executor_failing_hook_does_not_block_subsequent
nodes.summary: Verifies a failing hook does not prevent other hooks for the same event from running and reporting results.

nodes.name: stop_hook_receives_turn_metadata_env_vars
nodes.summary: Verifies Stop-event hooks receive turn-related metadata (turn id, tool call count) as env vars.

nodes.name: session_stop_hook_receives_status_env_var
nodes.summary: Verifies SessionStop hooks receive a session status env var.

nodes.name: config_parse_prompt_hook
nodes.summary: Verifies a prompt-type hook entry parses correctly from JSON.

nodes.name: collect_prompt_hooks_concatenates_content
nodes.summary: Verifies multiple prompt hooks for one event have their content concatenated by `collect_prompt_hooks`.

nodes.name: prompt_hook_run_returns_success_noop
nodes.summary: Verifies running a prompt-type hook via `HookExecutor::run` is a no-op that reports success.

nodes.name: config_parse_http_hook
nodes.summary: Verifies an http-type hook entry (url, method, headers) parses correctly from JSON.

nodes.name: http_method_default_is_post
nodes.summary: Verifies the default HTTP method for an http hook entry is POST when unspecified.

nodes.name: config_parse_mixed_hook_types
nodes.summary: Verifies a hooks.json mixing command, prompt, and http entries for the same event parses correctly.

nodes.name: new_events_serialize_correctly
nodes.summary: Verifies the newer lifecycle events (PrePromptBuild, PreCompaction, PostCompaction) serialize to the expected string form.

nodes.name: new_events_round_trip
nodes.summary: Verifies the newer lifecycle events round-trip through serialize/deserialize without loss.

nodes.name: parse_hook_decision_deny_blocks_tool
nodes.summary: Verifies a hook stdout of `{"decision": "deny"}` is parsed as a blocking intervention.

nodes.name: parse_hook_decision_deny_default_message
nodes.summary: Verifies a deny decision without an explicit reason falls back to a default block message.

nodes.name: parse_hook_decision_allow_with_updated_input
nodes.summary: Verifies an allow decision carrying updated tool input is parsed and surfaced correctly.

nodes.name: single_command_executor
nodes.summary: Test helper that builds a `HookExecutor` configured with a single command hook for a given event.

nodes.name: fire_pre_compaction_passes_trigger_and_count_and_waits
nodes.summary: Verifies `fire_pre_compaction` passes the compaction trigger and message count as env vars and awaits hook completion.

nodes.name: fire_post_compaction_passes_before_and_after_counts
nodes.summary: Verifies `fire_post_compaction` passes both before- and after-compaction message counts as env vars.

nodes.name: fire_notification_received_passes_message_excerpt
nodes.summary: Verifies `fire_notification_received` passes a truncated user-message excerpt as hook context.

nodes.name: compaction_dispatch_is_noop_without_matching_hooks
nodes.summary: Verifies compaction dispatch functions are no-ops when no hooks are registered for the compaction events.

nodes.name: bridge.rs
nodes.summary: Bridges connected MCP servers' tools into ORGII's internal `ToolRegistry` as `McpBridgeTool` instances, handling name normalization/collision avoidance, description truncation, disabled-tool filtering, and result conversion.

nodes.name: call_result_to_execute_result
nodes.summary: Converts an MCP tool call result into ORGII's internal `ToolExecuteResult`, preserving content blocks and `_meta` for the success path.

nodes.name: McpBridgeTool
nodes.summary: Adapter implementing ORGII's `Tool` trait over a single MCP server tool, forwarding `execute` calls to the underlying `McpClient::call_tool_typed`.

nodes.name: truncate_description
nodes.summary: Truncates an MCP tool's description to a maximum character count so oversized descriptions don't bloat the model's tool list.

nodes.name: normalize_name_for_mcp
nodes.summary: Normalizes a server or tool name into a safe identifier segment for building composite MCP tool names.

nodes.name: build_mcp_tool_name
nodes.summary: Builds the composite tool name (`mcp__server__tool`-style) used to expose an MCP tool in ORGII's tool registry, normalizing both segments.

nodes.name: should_skip_mcp_tool
nodes.summary: Determines whether an MCP tool should be excluded from registration because it or its server is disabled.

nodes.name: register_mcp_tools
nodes.summary: Registers every enabled tool from every connected MCP server into the `ToolRegistry`, building composite names and skipping disabled tools/servers.

nodes.name: call.rs
nodes.summary: Implements `McpClient::call_tool_typed` and its progress-aware variant — invoking an MCP tool with a timeout, classifying errors via `McpCallError`, and rendering the raw rmcp result into ORGII's content/text representation.

nodes.name: call_tool_typed
nodes.summary: Calls an MCP tool by name with typed arguments, applying the configured timeout, classifying any error, and rendering the result content/text.

nodes.name: call_tool_typed_with_progress
nodes.summary: Progress-aware variant of `call_tool_typed` that subscribes to a progress token before issuing the request so server-pushed progress notifications reach the caller.

nodes.name: record_error
nodes.summary: Records the most recent classified `McpCallError` on the client for status reporting and reconnect-counter bookkeeping.

nodes.name: connect.rs
nodes.summary: Implements `McpClient::connect` — spawning/dialing the configured transport (stdio, SSE, StreamableHttp), wiring OAuth credentials, stderr draining, and custom headers — plus `refresh_tools` for re-fetching the server's tool list.

nodes.name: spawn_stderr_drain
nodes.summary: Spawns a background task that drains a stdio MCP server child process's stderr into a bounded ring buffer for diagnostics.

nodes.name: build_custom_headers
nodes.summary: Converts a map of user-configured HTTP header strings into validated `HeaderMap` entries for SSE/StreamableHttp transports, without echoing header values in error messages.

nodes.name: load_stored_auth_client
nodes.summary: Loads a previously-stored OAuth `AuthClient` for a server/URL pair from the auth cache, if one exists.

nodes.name: serialize_tool_input_schema
nodes.summary: Serializes an MCP tool's typed input schema to a `serde_json::Value`, surfacing serialization failures as connection errors.

nodes.name: connect
nodes.summary: Establishes a connection to the MCP server over its configured transport (stdio spawn, SSE, or StreamableHttp with OAuth), completes the rmcp handshake, and populates the client's tool list.

nodes.name: refresh_tools
nodes.summary: Re-fetches the tool list from an already-connected MCP server and updates the client's cached tool definitions.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the `McpClient` struct and its shared state/status/content-rendering types; the struct's behavior (connect, call tools, list resources/prompts, lifecycle) is implemented across sibling files in this directory.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust impl-block-per-file pattern: `McpClient`'s methods are split across connect.rs, call.rs, state.rs, resources.rs, and prompts.rs rather than defined in one file.

nodes.name: McpToolDef
nodes.summary: Cached definition of a single tool exposed by an MCP server (name, description, input schema).

nodes.name: McpConnectionStatus
nodes.summary: Enum of an MCP server connection's lifecycle state (Connected, Disconnected, Error).

nodes.name: McpServerStatus
nodes.summary: Snapshot of an MCP server's current status for UI display: connection state, tool count, last error, transport type, and connected-at timestamp.

nodes.name: ServerCapabilities
nodes.summary: Subset of the MCP server's advertised capabilities (tools, resources, prompts) recorded after the initialize handshake.

nodes.name: McpClient
nodes.summary: Core client struct for one configured MCP server, holding its connection handle, cached tools, notification channel, and reconnect/error state; behavior is implemented in sibling files.

nodes.name: default_client_info
nodes.summary: Builds the `ClientInfo` advertised during the rmcp initialize handshake, deliberately leaving sampling and elicitation capabilities unset.

nodes.name: resolve_connect_timeout
nodes.summary: Resolves the effective connection timeout for a server, falling back to a default when not configured.

nodes.name: resolve_tool_timeout
nodes.summary: Resolves the effective per-tool-call timeout, honoring the `MCP_TOOL_TIMEOUT` environment override.

nodes.name: render_prompt_content
nodes.summary: Flattens an MCP prompt message's content blocks into a plain string for prompt rendering.

nodes.name: render_content
nodes.summary: Flattens an rmcp `Content` block list (text, image, audio, resource, resource_link) into a single display string, falling back to pretty-printed structured content when no blocks render.

nodes.name: extract_content_blocks
nodes.summary: Losslessly projects rmcp `Content` blocks into ORGII's provider-agnostic `ToolContentBlock` enum, preserving raw bytes/URIs for downstream consumers.

nodes.name: prompts.rs
nodes.summary: Implements `McpClient` prompt operations — listing available prompts and rendering a named prompt's messages into ORGII's prompt format.

nodes.name: has_prompts
nodes.summary: Reports whether the connected server advertised the prompts capability.

nodes.name: list_prompts
nodes.summary: Fetches and caches the list of prompts advertised by the MCP server.

nodes.name: get_prompt
nodes.summary: Fetches a named prompt's rendered messages from the MCP server with the given arguments, flattening each message's content via `render_prompt_content`.
